description: This file defines an interface named ActionSummary within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module, outlining methods for getting group ID, group name, and count of pending actions.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID as an integer.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name as a string.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending actions as an integer.
